course_loop — DRIVE course op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.course_loop(straight=80.0, radius=30.0, width=8.0, arc_pts=64, overlap=0.05) (to call the implementation directly, import drivecourse; drivecourse.course_loop(straight=80.0, radius=30.0, width=8.0, arc_pts=64, overlap=0.05); from the registry, opsdrive.get("course_loop"))

Usage

Loop course (oval): returns {"elements": [...], "placements": [...]} with 2 straights + 2 semicircles placed around the origin (pass it as is to course_layout). Counterclockwise: south straight (eastbound, y = −R) → east semicircle → north straight (westbound, y = +R) → west semicircle. The straights overlap the semicircles by overlap at both ends (an overlap so that no curb rises at the seams when converted to 3-D; the sum of the areas counts that part twice). Standard (ordinary license): a straight driving section of 80 m or more, width 8 m or more.
